_meta.description: Dependency version bump with a known CVE in a transitive dependency
_meta.teaching_point: The gate passes (no required fields missing) but risk is classified as critical due to the transitive CVE note. Escalate — not block — because the author provided evidence and context, but human review of the CVE is required before merging.

change_package.title: Bump requests from 2.28.1 to 2.31.0 (+ transitive urllib3 CVE note)
change_package.diff_text:
--- a/requirements.txt
+++ b/requirements.txt
@@ -14,2 +14,2 @@
-requests==2.28.1
+requests==2.31.0
 # Note: requests 2.31.0 pulls in urllib3 1.26.18 which has CVE-2023-43804
 # (moderate severity, HTTP request smuggling in proxied environments).
 # Our deployment does NOT use an HTTP proxy — assessed as unexploitable in context.
change_package.author_summary: Bumping requests to pick up security fixes in 2.29-2.31. Transitive urllib3 CVE-2023-43804 noted but assessed as unexploitable in our network topology (no proxies). Security team asked to confirm.
change_package.test_evidence: Integration tests pass: 112/112. Dependency audit: 1 known CVE (urllib3, assessed low risk for our environment).
change_package.rollback_plan: Revert requirements.txt. No DB or config changes.
